name: Augusta
summary: Maine's small capital on the Kennebec — the State House, the governor's mansion, and the oldest surviving wooden fort in the country.

lodging.name: A riverside hotel in Augusta
lodging.blurb: Simple base near the capitol complex and the Kennebec.

foodMustTry.name: A Maine Italian sandwich
foodMustTry.blurb: The state's own cold sub on a soft roll — a Kennebec Valley staple.

days.label: Day 29 — The Capital on the Kennebec
days.summary: Maine's seat of government and its colonial fort.

item.title: Maine State House & Blaine House
item.blurb: The 1832 granite capitol topped by a copper Minerva, with the governor's Blaine House across the lawn.

item.title: Old Fort Western
item.blurb: The oldest surviving wooden fort in the U.S. (1754), with costumed interpreters on the riverbank.
